tasks.short: Set and monitor product quality standards through samples and processing tests.

steps.what: Set and check the actual product quality limits, sampling plan and test requirements
inputs: actual product specification and process requirements
existing quality engineering advice
outputs: manager-checked product standards and test criteria

steps.what: Examine actual raw-product samples and direct or witness processing tests
inputs: actual raw product and in-process samples
manager-checked product standards and test criteria
outputs: actual checked sample and test observations

steps.what: Compare actual checked test values with approved quality limits using native quality charts
inputs: actual checked sample and test observations
manager-checked product standards and test criteria
outputs: manager-checked quality exceptions and trends

steps.what: Judge actual product conformity and decide required quality actions or standard changes
inputs: manager-checked quality exceptions and trends
actual checked sample and test observations
outputs: manager quality judgement and proposed actions

steps.what: Write and approve the final actual quality monitoring and standard decision record
inputs: manager quality judgement and proposed actions
manager-checked product standards and test criteria
outputs: approved final quality record and standard version

steps.what: Commit the approved final quality monitoring record and standard version
inputs: approved final quality record and standard version
outputs: saved quality monitoring and standard decision record

tasks.design: Configure native numeric limit comparisons and trend charts in {QUALITY_SYSTEM}, denoted OTHER. The manager sets actual standards, examines samples/directs tests and judges conformity. The chart identifies exact exceptions, not release decisions. Final record approval precedes separate same-system commit with no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Managers may repeatedly compare test rows and limits manually.
tasks.enabler_now: Native quality charts can apply exact units, limits and time windows to checked observations.
tasks.still_hard: Setting appropriate standards and deciding what a process deviation means.
tasks.human_edge: The manager relates sample evidence to the physical process and product requirements.
tasks.altitude: Human quality oversight with exact result comparison.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: quality systems can compare numeric test values against configured limits and plot trends.

assumptions: Shares are provisional; observe remaining manual comparison after current quality software. Existing charts, instrument runtime and tests receive no new benefit.

s1 captures/checks product_id, specification_version, limit, units and sampling_rule at full time. s2 captures actual batch_id, sample_id, test_time, measured_value and observed_condition at full time; existing laboratory staff supply normal signed results without new reporting. Missing or inconsistent data requires manual investigation.

s3 retains 8 hours for mapping checks and exception inspection; s4 retains complete physical/process judgement. No product release or standard dispatch is silently automated. Same-system commit stays full.
research_questions: Which numeric result comparisons are still repeated manually after current quality functions?

incremental.description: Maintain quality-limit mappings and audit units/versions

approvals.approved_version: s5 complete final actual quality record and standard version

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only comparison changes: 20 times 60% = 12 hours less 1 upkeep = 11. Low halves comparison benefit: 6 minus 1 = 5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct and coordinate industrial production, processing, distribution and marketing activities.

steps.what: Review actual order, production, distribution and demand status in a native operations view
inputs: existing actual production and distribution status
actual order demand and marketing commitments
outputs: manager-checked cross-functional operations picture

steps.what: Coordinate actual activities and resolve production, processing, distribution and marketing tradeoffs
inputs: manager-checked cross-functional operations picture
actual operational constraints and colleague proposals
outputs: manager-chosen coordination decisions

steps.what: Write the actual operational plan, priorities and named responsible owners
inputs: manager-chosen coordination decisions
outputs: complete candidate operational coordination plan

steps.what: Approve the complete final operational plan, constraints and internal recipients
inputs: complete candidate operational coordination plan
manager-checked cross-functional operations picture
outputs: approved final operations plan and recipients

steps.what: Send the approved final operational plan to the designated internal owners
inputs: approved final operations plan and recipients
outputs: sent final operational plan

steps.what: Capture and approve actual owner responses and any unresolved coordination issue
inputs: sent final operational plan
actual owner responses
outputs: approved final actual coordination status note

steps.what: Save the approved final coordination status note
inputs: approved final actual coordination status note
outputs: saved actual operational coordination status

tasks.design: Configure the {ERP} or {MANUFACTURING_SYSTEM} native operations view for actual orders, status and commitments. Reduce repeated status gathering while retaining managerial coordination and plan writing. Approve the complete plan before its separate internal send; record actual responses afterwards. Send and same-system save stay full.
tasks.previous_blocker: Managers may manually gather current status across separate operational views.
tasks.enabler_now: Native operations views can group existing order and production status.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving conflicting cost, service, capacity and market priorities.
tasks.human_edge: The manager aligns accountable people around feasible decisions.
tasks.altitude: Cross-functional operational judgement supported by actual status.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: ERP and manufacturing views can group actual order and operational status fields.

assumptions: Provisional shares require actual residual manual status gathering after existing native views. Existing order or stock calculations earn no new benefit.

Production, logistics and marketing already supply normal order_id, planned_quantity, completed_quantity, dispatch_status and committed_date in their operational records. No extra upstream reporting is assumed. s1 retains status freshness and scope checks; absent data requires manual coordination.

s3 captures actual agreed priorities, owners and dates at full time, s4 reviews the complete final plan, and s6 captures actual responses after sending. A sent plan is not completed production. No customer commitment is made automatically.
research_questions: Which actual status fields still require repeated manual gathering after current ERP views?

incremental.description: Maintain operational source mappings and status definitions

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final operations plan and internal recipients
s6 actual final coordination status note

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only status gathering changes: 20 times 50% = 10 hours less 1 upkeep = 9. Low halves gathering benefit: 5 minus 1 = 4.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review schedules and orders to decide inventory, staffing, procedures and duties within constraints.

steps.what: Check actual orders, inventory, qualified staff availability, budget and deadline constraints
inputs: existing actual processing schedule and production orders
current stock, staff availability, budget and deadlines
outputs: manager-checked production planning inputs

steps.what: Compare feasible schedule scenarios using native material, capacity and budget constraint checks
inputs: manager-checked production planning inputs
existing checked processing times and qualification rules
outputs: manager-checked feasible scenarios and constraint exceptions

steps.what: Choose inventory, staffing, work procedures and duty assignments within actual constraints
inputs: manager-checked feasible scenarios and constraint exceptions
actual operational context
outputs: manager-chosen production schedule and resource decisions

steps.what: Write and approve the complete final resource plan, schedule version and recipients
inputs: manager-chosen production schedule and resource decisions
manager-checked production planning inputs
outputs: approved final production resource plan and recipients

steps.what: Commit the approved final production resource plan and schedule version
inputs: approved final production resource plan and recipients
outputs: saved final production resource plan

steps.what: Send the approved final resource plan to the designated internal production owners
inputs: saved final production resource plan
approved final production resource plan and recipients
outputs: sent final production resource plan

tasks.design: Configure native {PRODUCTION_PLANNER} constraint scenarios rather than a model making assignments. Exact stock, time, capacity and budget checks expose feasible alternatives; the manager chooses inventory, staff and procedures. Approve the complete final plan before separate commit and internal send, both retained at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated manual schedule arithmetic can obscure material, capacity and budget conflicts.
tasks.enabler_now: Native planning scenarios can check exact constraints on current inputs.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing feasible priorities and fair staffing when requirements conflict.
tasks.human_edge: The manager understands practical process limits and staff circumstances.
tasks.altitude: Human production planning with native constraint comparison.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native production planning can compare material, capacity, budget and deadline constraints without selecting staff by inferred traits.

assumptions: All shares are provisional; observe residual manual scenario comparison after existing planning features. Existing scheduling runtime and generated plans earn no new saving.

Order and inventory owners supply existing order_id, quantity, due_date, stock_quantity and reservations; HR/roster owner supplies actual availability and validated qualifications, finance supplies authorised budget. s1 retains full verification and capture of missing authorised constraint values; missing data uses manual planning.
s2 retains 10 hours for setup, parameter checking and exception review. Manager sets priorities and every staffing decision in s3. No behavioural ranking or autonomous assignment is introduced.
s4 captures/checks the actual selected plan and recipients at full time. Changes require renewed approval before either final action; neither commit nor send receives a saving.
research_questions: Which constraint comparisons still require manual arithmetic after the existing production planner?

incremental.description: Maintain validated planning constraints and audit scenario exceptions

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final production plan and schedule version
s4 complete final production resource plan and exact internal recipients

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only scenario comparison changes: 25 times 60% = 15 hours less 1.5 upkeep = 13.5. Low halves comparison benefit: 7.5 minus 1.5 = 6.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review operations and confer with staff to resolve production problems.

steps.what: Review actual downtime, throughput and defect evidence in native operations exception views
inputs: actual operations event records
existing actual production orders and quality records
outputs: manager-checked production problem evidence

steps.what: Confer with technical and administrative staff to diagnose and resolve the actual processing problem
inputs: manager-checked production problem evidence
actual staff explanations and operational observations
outputs: actual problem discussion and selected resolution

steps.what: Write and approve the complete final resolution, responsible owners and internal recipients
inputs: actual problem discussion and selected resolution
manager-checked production problem evidence
outputs: approved final production resolution and recipients

steps.what: Send the approved final production resolution to its designated internal owners
inputs: approved final production resolution and recipients
outputs: sent final production resolution

steps.what: Capture and approve actual responses and unresolved production problem status
inputs: sent final production resolution
actual owner responses and checked operational outcome
outputs: approved final actual production problem status note

steps.what: Save the approved final production problem status note
inputs: approved final actual production problem status note
outputs: saved actual production problem status

tasks.design: Configure native {MANUFACTURING_SYSTEM} exception views for actual events and orders. Reduce evidence gathering, not diagnosis or staff discussion. Write and approve the complete resolution before separate internal send; record actual outcomes afterwards. Send and same-system save remain fully retained.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual problem evidence may need repeated manual gathering across operations logs.
tasks.enabler_now: Native exception views can group actual downtime, throughput and quality evidence.
tasks.still_hard: Finding root causes and agreeing a workable resolution.
tasks.human_edge: The manager combines staff knowledge with actual operating conditions.
tasks.altitude: Human production problem resolution with checked event evidence.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native manufacturing exception views can group actual recorded events by order and time.

assumptions: All shares are provisional; check remaining manual evidence gathering after current native views. Existing telemetry and calculations earn no new benefit.

Operators, equipment and quality staff supply their normal existing order_id, event_time, downtime_reason, quantity and defect_record. No new uncounted reason coding is assumed. s1 retains source checking; missing reasons require manual investigation.

s3 captures and approves actual resolution and owners at full time after discussion. s5 records actual responses and observed outcome, not assumed success after sending. Changed resolution returns to final approval. Same-system save remains full.
research_questions: Which actual problem evidence still requires manual gathering after current operations views?

incremental.description: Maintain event mappings and audit exception view omissions

approvals.approved_version: s3 complete final production resolution and recipients
s5 actual final production problem status note
